app.name: Cercube for YouTube
app.subtitle: Offline, PiP, background play and no ads for YouTube
app.description: Cercube for YouTube is the official YouTube enhancement from the original Cercube developer, relaunched in 2026: cache media for offline playback, use Picture in Picture and background playback, block supported video, feed and Shorts ads, choose default playback quality separately for Wi-Fi and cellular, reorder or hide tabs, auto-replay, skip sponsored segments, show dislike counts, queue videos - in 14 languages. It hooks the App Store YouTube app. Official distribution: apt.cercube.com (rootful, rootless and roothide jailbreak) and the altstore.cercube.com sideload source for AltStore (Classic), SideStore, Feather, eSign and friends.
